governance.limitations: Opt-in installation events, not people or all installations. No cross-device attribution. All admitted events are sampled at 100% until fixed rate/queue limits; offline, revoked, unsupported and dropped clients are missing. Ingestion tokens are forgeable; these are not audit or authorization records.

events.name: keeper_app_ready
events.description: Application readiness duration, not browser web vitals or Rust startup completeness.

events.name: keeper_command_palette_opened
events.description: Explicit command palette opening; contains no command, search text or account data.

events.name: keeper_settings_opened
events.description: Explicit settings opening; contains no setting values or account data.

events.name: keeper_frontend_error
events.description: Closed frontend error category; no exception message, stack or payload.

events.name: keeper_interaction
events.description: Bounded interaction duration; no target text or input values.

remoteConfig.supportMessage: Optional diagnostics contain no messages, filenames, notes or recordings.

personas.name: keeper-persona-palette-30d
personas.description: Behavioral segment of consented palette activity in 30 days, not an inferred human identity. Personless ingestion may leave person-based cohort membership empty; never enrich people to fill this cohort.

personas.name: keeper-persona-settings-30d
personas.description: Behavioral segment of consented settings activity in 30 days, not a demographic persona. Personless ingestion may leave person-based cohort membership empty; never enrich people to fill this cohort.

metrics.name: keeper_palette_active_installations_30d
metrics.description: Personless behavioral segment: distinct consented installation IDs with palette activity in 30 days, not people. No profiles or cross-device linkage. Synthetic events are excluded; reinstall/identity resets, opt-in bias, rate/queue limits and offline clients prevent population estimates.
metrics.sql: SELECT uniqExact(distinct_id) AS installation_count FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'keeper_command_palette_opened' AND properties.consent_category = 'productAnalytics' AND properties.synthetic = false

metrics.name: keeper_settings_active_installations_30d
metrics.description: Personless behavioral segment: distinct consented installation IDs with settings activity in 30 days, not people. No profiles or cross-device linkage. Synthetic events are excluded; reinstall/identity resets, opt-in bias, rate/queue limits and offline clients prevent population estimates.
metrics.sql: SELECT uniqExact(distinct_id) AS installation_count FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'keeper_settings_opened' AND properties.consent_category = 'productAnalytics' AND properties.synthetic = false

metrics.name: keeper_product_events_7d
metrics.description: Opt-in palette and settings event counts in seven days, not active people or total adoption. Excludes synthetic records. Sampling, revocation, queue/rate limits and offline clients bias the observed population; public tokens are forgeable.
metrics.sql: SELECT count() AS event_count FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND event IN ('keeper_command_palette_opened', 'keeper_settings_opened') AND properties.consent_category = 'productAnalytics' AND properties.synthetic = false

metrics.name: keeper_ready_p95_ms_7d
metrics.description: Readiness p95 among observed diagnostics-consenting installations, not web vitals or a whole-population SLA. Excludes synthetic and absent durations; rate/queue limits, offline clients and revocation create missing observations.
metrics.sql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)) AS p95_ms FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND event = 'keeper_app_ready' AND properties.consent_category = 'diagnostics' AND properties.synthetic = false AND properties.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) >= 0 AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) <= 600000

dashboard.name: keeper-observability-proposed
dashboard.description: Keeper managed definitions. Proposed, noncanonical metrics; consented and incomplete client observations only. No person identity, content, revenue or total-installation claims.

sourceMappings.scope: Future separately consented website events only; no cross-project identity joins.
Future separately consented website events only; no ad-account mapping inferred.

marketing.attribution: No current Keeper event sends UTM values. Missing source remains unattributed, never direct. Source mappings are maintainer-owned boundary definitions, not changes to tgsite or an advertising integration. No revenue or customer conversion is claimed.
